en.about_bio: Building interactive audio systems and pipeline tools for games. Specialized in Wwise, FMOD, Unreal Engine, and C++/C# development.
en.timeline_dae_desc: Specialized in audio integration, Wwise/FMOD middleware, and professional game audio pipelines at Howest Belgium.
en.timeline_middleware_desc: Wwise & FMOD in Unreal and Unity. Spatial audio, dynamic mixing, Game Syncs for professional game audio workflows.
en.timeline_music_desc: Started releasing music on Spotify. Electronic, film scoring, experimental sound design.
en.timeline_piano_desc: Classical piano education at First Degree State Music School in Kołobrzeg, Poland.
en.timeline_hs_desc: Studied mathematics, physics, and computer science at Nicolaus Copernicus High School in Kołobrzeg, Poland.
en.tech_wwise_desc: RTPCs, States/Switches, HDR mixing, attenuation curves, music system design
en.tech_fmod_desc: Event-based implementation, parameters, adaptive music, 3D spatialization
en.tech_metasounds_desc: Procedural audio, parametric sound design, real-time modulation systems
en.tech_unreal_desc: Sound Cues, Blueprints, Audio submixes, Concurrency, Attenuation, MetaSounds integration
en.tech_unity_desc: Audio Mixer, C# scripting for audio, middleware integration (Wwise/FMOD)
en.tech_reaper_desc: Sound design, SFX editing, batch processing, custom scripts, game audio workflows
en.tech_logic_desc: Music composition, MIDI sequencing, orchestral arrangements
en.tech_python_desc: Audio analysis (LibROSA), ML models (scikit-learn), automation tools, OSC communication
en.tech_csharp_desc: Unity audio scripting, custom audio tools, middleware integration
en.tech_blueprints_desc: Audio triggers, parameter control, event systems, gameplay integration
en.tech_maxmsp_desc: Real-time DSP, generative audio, prototyping interactive systems
en.tech_rx_desc: Audio restoration, dialogue cleaning, spectral editing
en.tech_fabfilter_desc: Pro-Q 3, Pro-L 2, Pro-MB – mixing, mastering, frequency sculpting
en.value_systems_desc: Not Today Darling: 3-layer music that changes with race intensity. Pause & Deserve: horror audio that responds to how you use pause.
en.value_tools_desc: Wwise Unreal Fixer: fixes 200+ broken references after Wwise updates. Unreal Rebuilder: cuts build time in half. AudioLab: ML beatbox classifier with 45ms latency.
en.value_technical_desc: AudioQ EQ plugin in C++/JUCE. Python ML for beatbox classification. Blueprint hooks for Wwise events. Memory profiling in Unreal.
en.principle_clarity_desc: Game audio needs to be clear. What does the player need to hear right now? Mix hierarchy, frequency separation, ducking. Player gets info, not noise.
en.principle_technical_desc: Understanding limits helps: voice counts, memory, CPU. I build systems that work in prototype and scale to production without breaking budget.
en.principle_layering_desc: I design sounds in layers: transient for punch, body for weight, texture for character. Parameters (speed, intensity, distance) blend them in real-time. Sounds respond to gameplay.
en.principle_collaboration_desc: Audio needs input from designers, programmers, and players. I document systems, explain decisions, and iterate based on playtests. Audio ships when the game ships.
en.cta_desc: Looking for 2026 internship opportunities in game audio. Let's build something great.
en.achievement_thesis_desc: Research on real-time AI audio for games (separate from AudioLab). Built Unity + ElevenLabs API prototype for generative music and ambience. Got sub-500ms response time (audio input → AI generation → game output) to test if AI audio works for interactive gameplay
en.achievement_tools_desc: Built 2 critical pipeline tools: Wwise Unreal Fixer and Unreal Engine Rebuilder
en.achievement_games_desc: Led audio implementation on 4 team-based games at DAE. Contributed sound design to 8+ additional student projects
